newsitem.title: UK: Dlr regains footing vs mark after profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Dlr regains footing vs mark after profit-taking.

text.p: 0825 - Dlr firms vs mark after overnight profit-taking forced it off Monday highs. Stg supported below 3.00 marks after Monday battering but remains shaky, cable soft as dollar rebounds. Dlr/yen capped after U.S. trade rep Barshefsky says trend in U.S.-Japan auto trade deficit was unacceptable. US Q2 employment cost index at 1230GMT. July consumer confidence at 1400GMT.
